tasks.title: Bound evidence context and preserve honest large-file outcomes
acceptance: 8 KiB and 32 KiB reads retain full results and hashes; LLM input stays <=6000 serialized UTF-8 bytes without hidden source truncation.
32 KiB create arguments never need to be copied into final context or an append revision; action identity and approval remain immutable.
Partial semantic coverage produces terminal partial with evidence, never a false full-analysis claim or repeated context-budget pause; resume never replays verified actions.

tasks.title: Protect and expire private approval previews
acceptance: Create full previews with verified user-only protected Windows DACL or POSIX 0600 inside private directory; stdout contains no proposed content.
Enforce 15-minute expiry, 256 KiB/file and 64 tracked previews; clean only registered expired identities on creation or explicit cleanup-previews.
Reject symlink/junction/substitution and unsafe permissions; failures do not expose content or delete foreign objects; ordinary deletion is not secure erasure.

Windows/Ubuntu regression, schema/combined DAG, Ruff, wheel and isolated installed-package checks pass with explicit platform skips.
